CheckTitle: ECS task definitions do not add dangerous Linux capabilities
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices
Description: Checks whether ECS task definitions explicitly add the SYS_ADMIN or ALL Linux capabilities to containers.
Risk: Dangerous Linux capabilities can weaken container isolation and increase the impact of a container compromise.

Code.Other: Create a new ECS task definition revision and remove SYS_ADMIN or ALL from linuxParameters.capabilities.add unless explicitly required.

Recommendation.Text: Apply the principle of least privilege. Avoid adding SYS_ADMIN or ALL capabilities to ECS containers unless strictly necessary.
